name: Egg White Carrot Brownies
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 100 g dark cooking chocolate, melted and cooled slightly
100 g butter, melted and cooled slightly

steps: Whip the egg whites, gradually adding the sugar, until stiff.
Stir in the flour and mix well.
Add the carrots, lemon peel, walnuts, melted chocolate, and melted butter. Mix well.
Pour the batter into the a greased baking pan. Bake at 350°F until cooked through.
Once cool, cut into pieces and sprinkle with powdered sugar.
